title: Spatial Alignment, Hand Tracking & Image-to-3D · v0.8.0
changes: Luminous green ENTER / XR portal with guided pulse and reduced-motion support.
Upright camera-facing world-space navigation; smoothly damped Follow with header-drag offsets; Pin stays in room.
Capture eye eases separately; every new source capture is placed relative to the current headset, not the toolbar or original XR entry point.
Selected source and object actions attach directly below the image and inherit its rotation; general navigation is no longer duplicated.
WebXR tracked hand-joint skeleton, controller/hand rays, and depth-sensing availability diagnostics. Physical-depth occlusion is not yet enabled.
Meshy image-to-3D tasks require a configured server vault key and explicit paid confirmation; private owner-scoped job records, progress, credits and GLB links.
No automatic image analysis or 3D generation; prior SQLite data and request limits are retained. Watcher unchanged.
